entry.title: Mario Kart Wii v0.3.2
entry.content:
## Release Version 0.3.2: Deathlink Amnesty & Fixes :) Added deathlink amnesty, so you can make those deathlinks a little less punishing. I also rewrote some stuff that will help later for a ntsc implementation to the same client. I also fixed some common glitches and frustrations to both the tracker and the client. If you want to help index the memory adresses, pointers and constants for ntsc, check out the `./worlds/mkwii/"MKWii Client"/dme_addresses.py` script, it houses all the current memory addresses, pointers and constants for pal. These all need to be translated to ntsc for the client to work. Your help is greatly appreciated, as I do not own a ntsc copy.
### Changelog: - [APWorld] Added support for deathlink amnesty. - [Client] Added support for deathlink amnesty. - [Client] Added some fun deathlink messages, they are randomly chosen. - [Client] Rewrote parts of client regarding future-proofing for _future_ ntsc support. - [Client] Rewrote reporting logic. - [Client] Fixed mirror mode not unlocking when starting off with a mirror cup as one of your starting cups. - [Tracker] Removed bloated dependency to decrease file size by approximately 60% (was already included in the build last time but not on the source). - [Tracker] Fixed issue where another game's release/completion would obstruct vision of completion on cups screen.
**REQUIRES THIS NEW APWORLD** _(it can run on the 0.3.1 APWorld but deathlink amnesty will NOT work)_
_Linux users, download the source code here to run the client._
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/toent/Archipelago-MKWii/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.5.2
entry.content:
And with this, Verdania is fully mapped and every area is done (on a base level). Split directions and enemy mapping are being worked on but the totals are looking incredible, shoutouts to the mappers for being crazy productive people. Anyway here's another week full of logic adjustments, bug fixes and some new features (Also usual small offer to [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) if you feel like supporting this)
# Major
- Added completed Verdania logic (by Pyxl) - Completely reworked Slabs logic (by Maya) - Completely reworked Choral Chambers logic (by Gallos) - Several other areas got logic updates as well - Added the Split/Directional Abilities category, Damage Boost Logic and Platforming Capability got expanded to now include Elite Ball Knowledge (which is Proficient Movement + extremely specific game knowledge that even Proficient Movement doesn't cover) - Added optional Left/Right versions of Cling Grip, Ledge Grab, Clawline and Swift Step. Split Dash/Sprint keeps sprint unrestricted - Please note that the mappers are still working on adding split directions for their areas so not all areas support them fully yet, each update will further improve on this
# Minor / Bugfixes
* Some locations now no longer share the generic "Shell Shard Cache 1, 2, 3, etc" scheme and instead are given more discriptive names. The mappers are still working on renaming them all so please be patient * Added some missing UT maps, overall adjusted UT map marker positions * Fixed blacked-out passages in Memorium (Arborium_06) when entering from the left * Fixed fog obscuring Greymoor's hidden right entrance (Greymoor_02) * Fixed Greyroot giving no dialogue after completing her shuffled wish * Sylphsong now resumes during the same bench rest that removes a Cursed Crest Trap * Fixed missing randomized Shaman Crest Slot checks in Act 2 seeds * Fixed Craftmetal/Crest Slot generation repair bugs * Corrected unnecessary Act 3 gates for Khann and Nyleth * Fixed Pristine Core logic to require collecting Architect Crests location * Fixed completing Ecstasy of the End early making the Egg of Flealia check unavailable * Fixed duplicate Sherma when completing Balm for the Wounded before meeting him in Songclave * Fixed lingering Magma Bell HUD effects during Naked Trap, including while sizzling * Randomized Craw Summons now appears on the first eligible bench rest * Fixed Fleatopia Supplies appearing in logic before the caravan reaches Fleatopia * Fixed later Jubilana purchases appearing in logic before both rescues and her shop are available * Added Conjoined Heart to Old Heart randomization * Fixed the cursed crest blocking Eva and other required NPCs * Added Enter to connect from the Connection tab without clicking the button * Fixed Wish Shuffle marking Bone Bottom Supplies as available while Flick is still building the wish board * Fixed a rare DeathLink issue where an old connection could deliver a death after reconnecting or switching slots * Updated Fleatopia's minigame requirements * F4 warp can now be done in the main AP inventory page, the location can also be toggled between unlocked ones next to it * Prevented early Savage Beastfly wishes from removing Fourth Chorus's platforms before its defeat * Fixed KnockbackLink rejecting knockbacks because players' PC clocks differ * Fixed Fatal Resolve's wish offer appearing in logic before its required Act 3 shaman meeting * Corrected Silk and Soul logic for caravan progression, Flexile Spines and several wish-point contributions * Fixed shuffled wishes potentially blocking progression into Act 3 * Fixed Clawline allowing use of an unowned Drifter's Cloak * Fixed Drifter's Cloak wall-grabbing depending on visiting Cling Grip's original location * Boss Credits now explain their effects in the AP inventory * Phantom's Boss Credit now stops exhaust in the Organ, Underworks and Bilewater * Clearing the Mist and unlocking the lift still require defeat * Verdania stays open even after defeating the Clover Dancers * Added Palestag Boss Credit * Improved (idiot proofed) Craftmetal spending * Fixed Whispering Vaults’ bottom entrance incorrectly putting locations in logic before you could climb out of the entrance area * Fixed several locations incorrectly requiring Craw Lake completion or Clawline despite having another valid route * Reduced the delay before randomized flea rewards are sent * Adjusted Herobrine to only target players who have benchwarp installed * Removed Far Fields - Shell Shard Cache 8 and the inscription on First Sinner's door * Fixed the Mosshome Moss Plaque check becoming unavailable after using Needolin * Fixed uncollected Beast Shard rewards from Rhinogrund failing to return after leaving the room or dying * Fixed Bone Bottom, Bellhart and Songclave disappearing from F4 destinations in Act 3 * Fixed Whispering Vaults appearing reachable through the unopened Underworks elevator shortcut * Fixed duplicate handling of the Pilgrim's Rest Tool Pouch location * Wardenfly captures now count as routes into the Slab * Overworld Wardenflies no longer disappear because of Slab progress or Act 3 * Killed Wardenflies return when you leave and re-enter their room * Added Key of Indolent and Key of Heretic to Major Key randomization * Starting with Shaman or another later-act crest now keeps Hunter available in earlier-goal runs, including its randomized slot locations and items * Fixed excluded crest slots waiting for AP items that don’t exist * Fixed Nuu's scroll entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.3
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **`!ap loadout` equips weapons you don't own.** Pick a slot, then any weapon your class can hold in it. The list puts the weapons with the most Archipelago buffs first and shows how many each one has. Stock weapons are not listed, since you already have them: Reset at the end of the list puts your own weapon back. The choice lasts until you leave the server. It applies at once in the spawn room or between waves, otherwise at your next resupply. Slots the run has not unlocked stay locked. Upgrades you buy for the chosen weapon stay on it, the same as for a weapon from your backpack. We tested the weapon swaps and the upgrades on a server with a scripted player, but no real player has opened the menu yet. - **Nuke, next to Repair in Settings.** It deletes the game server, SteamCMD and the downloads, and the next start installs them again from nothing, 14 GB included. Repair keeps the game files; Nuke does not. The run and its checks, your settings, the player file and your community content folder stay. It asks before it does anything. ### Fixed - **Servers work on the TF2 update of 16 October 2026.** Windows SigMod servers no longer refuse to start or crash on every community mission, and the defender bots read item and attribute data correctly again on Windows and Linux. - **Windows SigMod servers play every community mission to the end.** The test servers now clear all 532 waves of the SigMod community missions. - **Spy stabs alert nearby robots** on Linux SigMod servers. - **The Your Eternal Reward unnerf works again on Linux.** The last TF2 update had broken it. - **More SigMod mods work on Windows servers:** 254 of the 309 mods now load in full. - **Caliginous Caper wave 666 no longer ends when the 64 Spies die.** Valve lists the tanks that wait for the Spies ahead of them, and the game ends the wave on the tick the last Spy dies, before the tanks, the crit robots and the Uber Medics that follow. The repaired file now lists each group after the ones it waits for. The server writes it again at start. - **Weapon buffs no longer pile up on Windows servers.** Each time the game rebuilt your buffs, the reserve ammo and the health you were holding went up by the buff again, and switching weapons rebuilds them twice. A +25% reserve ammo buff read 511, 797, 1243 and kept going, and a max health buff added its amount to your health every time. The buffs themselves were right. The plugin now puts back the ammo and health a rebuild raised. It does not top up your ammo or health when you first earn a buff; the next resupply does that. The Linux server we measured did not do this. We ran ten rebuilds in a row on a Windows and a Linux server with scripted defender bots, but no real player has checked it yet. - **Windows servers run on the 2026-10-14 TF2 update.** The update moved the game code SigMod patches, and a SigMod built for the old game refuses to load on the new one. The Windows launcher now installs a SigMod built for TF2 11117211. Missions that need SigMod load again. - **Windows SigMod servers no longer crash when bots use items or when a mission is cleared.** A bot using an item (a canteen, say) could crash the server, and so could clearing a mission with a thousand robots or more. Both came from game functions the Windows SigMod had not found. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots; all but one mission played through, and that one still stops at its first wave. - **More SigMod mods work on a Windows server.** Weapon effects, death yells and entity limits did nothing there, because the Windows SigMod had not found the game functions they hook. They now run. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots: five of eight groups played through. Three missions still lose waves (Dismal Devilry, Dust to Dust and Trespasser Remaster) and are being looked at. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(ci): hand the release and the nightly the extensions they now need by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/221 * chore(release): 1.18.3 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/222 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.2...v1.18.3 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZTVlYTA2MGNiMmYwODFjNDE3ZGJiYzE5Yzg1ZWUyOTc6MTc5MjM1NjAwMg==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YmUwOTdmNzVlOTgxMDM4MWQ0YzVmMDMyNmMxNDE5ZTI6MTc5MjM1NjAwNQ==/detection)

entry.title: Spyro 2 v2.2.0
entry.content:
This release modifies both the Duckstation client (S2AP.Desktop.exe) and the APWorld (including the Bizhawk client). This release is not compatible with previous versions. As this release patches a significant DataStorage usage issue with the Duckstation client, full gemsanity players are urged to update immediately.
New Features: - Players can now menu out of Glimmer before entering Summer Forest for the first time. - Game overs prior to entering Summer Forest continue to redirect the player to Glimmer, as in vanilla.
Changes: - The minimum supported AP version is now 0.6.6, up from 0.6.1. - Most users will no longer need to run the Duckstation client in admin mode. This is no longer forced on opening it. - Gemsanity Rework - Gem locations and items are now separated. - The player may specify how many gems to become locations. - Gems will behave normally if only locations are added. - Adding 500 or more locations requires host approval. - Simplified gem item options. - When choosing gem bundles or full gemsanity, the player's gem location count may be overridden to provide enough locations. - If not logically required, red gems are now filler items. Otherwise, they are converted to green and blue gems. - This significantly improves the speed of generation and success rate for full gemsanity. - When Level Locks are on, beating Ripto unlocks Dragon Shores permanently. - The lock now only prevents entering from out of bounds. - The trick enabling wall access from Zephyr with Double Jump now also grants access to the two gems outside Metro Speedway into logic. (Coded by PhoenixAki)
Bug Fixes - [Duckstation] Fixed a critical bug where inefficient DataStorage use could cause issues up to and including crashes in full gemsanity seeds. - Fixed a logic error that incorrectly handled the warp from Crush to Autumn Plains when the player had swim but not climb. - [Bizhawk] Fixed a pair of bugs around Sparx range and the Lazy Sparx Trap. - Fixed a bug where loading into an in-progress gemsanity seed could release checks based on your vanilla progression instead of your AP progression. - [Duckstation] Fixed a bug where connecting before in game could cause filler items received offline to be lost. - Fixed a bug where Elora could let the player into the Ripto fight early under rare circumstances.

entry.title: Baldur's Gate 3 v0.8.0
entry.content:
Baldur's Gate 3 Archipelago Version 0.8.0 BETA:
Release of Act 3! Support for Questsanity, Killsanity and Containersanity. Questsanity has been untested. Block Entrances has been untested. I make no guarantees either option is even playable. I have used the ap_out of my successful run to run as test verification against killsanity and containersanity, so those should at least be playable, but I have not done much examination regarding what kills/containers may exist in alternative configurations of act 3's events.
Also included in this release: * Changed default yaml to be Killsanity instead of Questsanity * Removed Sync Method from the yaml options (after the 0.7.0 revamp it wasn't very relevant) * Improved some documentation (options have location count updates, a warning on Confusion traps, revamped the setup docs to treat this release as source of truth) * Fixed a logic glitch that would force Underwell access too early * Fixed the "Find Benryn" location to have more triggers * Renamed "Nightsong: Enter Underdark" to "... through Temple" since apparently it only triggers that direction. * Minor fixes to Act 1+2 containersanity * Filtered out summons from killsanity logs because they're never locations and the @$#%@#% wizards in act 3 spam like nothing * Fixed the Waypoint lockout- Act 2 Shar Trials and Act 3 should no longer remove waypoints from the waypoint list. I _don't_ know how successful this is at actually being able to visit old waypoints and accomplishing things, but it seemed like a good start. * Some mild revamps to the container highlight aura for optimization.

entry.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.7
entry.content: This update fixes several crafting and item-delivery issues, expands weapon upgrades, and improves playing with Archipelago disabled. Rejoice vanilla enjoyers! **Crafting and progression** - Fixed weapon-material and blueprint crates appearing already opened when you owned their reward through another source. Owning a Rusty Spring, for example, no longer prevents collecting its crate’s location check. - Corrected Crafting mode blueprint rewards. A weapon blueprint now grants only its blueprint, while its crafting material remains a separate item. Starting with both grants one of each. - Added recovery for missing blueprints you previously received through Archipelago. Recipes already learned at the blacksmith remain recognized without repeatedly restoring paper blueprints. - Fixed a potential Crafting mode progression lock. Shotgun access now accounts for completing A Heart for Poochie and reaching the Bones needed for crafting in Where Rock Bleeds. - Heartglaze Flower can no longer be placed at Quest Complete: Old Warfare in Crafting mode. - Updated tracker explanations to reflect the corrected shotgun crafting requirements. **Weapon upgrades** - Added Pistol upgrade support. - All six weapons now have **three separate upgrades** available: Pistol, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, and Crossbow. - Both Direct and Crafting modes now contain **18 weapon upgrades total**. These replace filler items without adding more location checks. - Upgrades received before obtaining a weapon are held until that weapon is acquired or crafted. - Fixed upgrade handling that could apply the same received upgrades more than once during recovery or reconnecting. **Item delivery and recovery** - Fixed missing or heavily delayed item deliveries, including starting Viscera, ingredients, key items, and weapon upgrades. - Improved delivery during loading and save transitions so items wait until the active run is ready. - Fixed Recent AP Activity failing to display received items and completed locations. - Fixed an issue where finding an item at its original vanilla location could remove the newly received Archipelago reward. This affected Fogg’s Drumsticks and could affect other quest items. - Improved recovery of previously received items while respecting quest items already turned in and blueprints already learned. **Playing with AP Off** - Fixed vanilla rewards being blocked while Archipelago was disabled. - AP Off now bypasses randomizer item handling, progression repairs, location reporting, and DeathLink behavior. - Randomizer cutscene skips are ignored while AP is disabled, including the Jakob death scene. - Archipelago Viscera protection settings no longer override vanilla money-bag behavior in AP Off. - AP gameplay overlays remain hidden while playing with Archipelago disabled. **Performance and presentation** - Reduced unnecessary overlay and title-screen updates while keeping item delivery running independently. - Disabled repetitive map-visibility logging by default to reduce unnecessary background work. - Added elapsed timestamps to Recent AP Activity so players can distinguish when events occurred. - Styled activity timestamps in a muted slate gray to keep the focus on item and location messages. **Updating** Plenty of optimization and performance improvements, so it's highly recommend to update if you are currently playing on an older version. You only need to update the `APWorld` and `LaikaMod.dll` file as always. That's all for now! I apologize Crafting mode enjoyers for making you have to wait, but I hope these new quality of life changes make it worth it. As always, please report any further issues in in the Laika Discord channel on the Archipelago Discord!

entry.title: Dragon Quest IX v0.2.0
entry.content:
# Dragon Quest IX - Beta Release (Version 0.2.0)
**This is a beta release. Things can possibly break, though the core gameplay should run normally.**
*This requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer!*** *This **is not** compatible with seeds generated on an earlier version*
New to the game? Check out the [FAQ](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1427594624389742716/1491731616068800543) ## Bugs fixed
* Removed DLC only location "Stornway Castle - Cellar"
## New Feature: Shop Randomization
After a lot of trial and error, and with help of the Ap community, Shop Randomization is here! You can choose from the following options, how much / if you want to randomize shops: * "None" => Do not randomize Shops * "Same Shop Type" => Shops of the same type are randomized * "Same Region" => Shops in the same region are randomized * "Same Shop Type And Region" => Shops of the same type and in the same region are randomized * "True Random" => All Shops get randomized together
Generation may fail <1% of the time, in such a case just try again :)
## New Feature and Change: Patch Files
Dragon Quest IX now also makes use of a patch file to put it's data into the game where it is possible. When generation, you will find a `.apdqix` file in the output - open it via the "Open Patch" Option in the launcher, or just double click it from your Downloads.
This will ask for your copy of the game as well as the EmuHawk executable, if not already set form playing other games. Once set up, it automatically runs BizHawk with the patched ROM - have fun!
If you continue your run later, just re-open the modified ROM, which should be placed in the same folder where you have your original ROM.

entry.title: Lethal Company v0.8.0
entry.content:
# THIS AND ALL FUTURE VERSIONS ARE NOT COMPATIBLE WITH WORLDS CREATED PRIOR TO 0.8.0
It's finally here. Below you will find all changes since v0.7.13, including the ones listed in both pre-releases.
Mod: * completely switched from LethalLevelLoader to DawnLib and replaced commands that used LethalAPI Terminal with Dawn commands * updated MultiClient.Net to the latest stable version * made custom company moons (Galetry, Oxyde, etc.) share logic with Gordion * scrap that spawns in custom interiors is now in logic * fixed an issue where non-scrap (flashlights, spray paint, etc.) in a custom moon's scrap pool could have locations * MASSIVELY reduced the time taken to connect to a multiworld slot * collecting a goal item now displays a notification in the ship (this may be blocked by the report card) * fixed moon difficulty calculation (i.e. 'hard' moons now reference the correct yaml setting for grade locations) * added a new option for calculating moon difficulty * added the moon grade required for grade locations to the in-game tracker * fixed an issue where some moons incorrectly cost credits to visit * added a mod config option to reduce the amount of scrap that spawns on Dine * custom world names (set when using the 'apworld' command) are now saved * added more space after the locked moon text * GetGameLogic is no longer called twice when connecting to a multiworld * added a terminal command that gets the logic string without UnityExplorer * cloned scrap now parent to the ship correctly * the custom world name set using the 'apworld' command is now correctly shared with clients * the apworld and mod version are now displayed in the log output (so I'll know if you try to mix incompatible versions) * extra inventory slots added by mods should now be useable when the player has all four vanilla ones unlocked
Apworld: * changed moon checks to grade locations (ex. 'Vow check 1' is now 'Vow Grade Location 1') * for the sake of clarity, locations and items are no longer referred to as 'checks' anywhere in the mod or apworld * reworked the Collectathon goal * it now requires the player to collect an assortment of random scrap in addition to the ap chests * players can now set min_scrap_chance and min_monster_chance to 0 without encountering issues * fixed a logic issue where rare scrap and monsters could still have certain progression items * the gold bar scrap is no longer always excluded * slightly tweaked custom content instructions for clarity * removed numbers from moon names for clarity * fixed the credit hunt goal generating an incorrect amount of company credit items * stamina and inventory changes * the player always has 4 stamina bars and 4 inventory slots in the item pool * the initial amount of stamina and inventory specified in the yaml options are now add to the player's starting inventory * quota locations now require three inventory slots and two stamina bars before they become in-logic * made a tiny change to mitigate errors when generating scrap regions * documentation updates and minor setting tweaks * rewrote most of the setup guide * rewrote some option descriptions * reduced money_per_quota_location minimum from 100 to 50 and maximum from 10000 to 2000 * reduced quota_checkpoint_every default value from 5 to 3
Known issues: * If a player connects to a slot that has modify_scrap_spawns, scrap spawns will remain modified for until the player closes the game, even if the player opens a different save file. * Connecting to a multiworld with a large amount of custom content may take up to a few minutes.

entry.title: Creeper World 4 v0.2.2
entry.content:
Matched pair: install the plugin zip AND regenerate with this `cw4.apworld`. The plugin and the apworld share a version number and must match.
Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
**Existing yamls keep working.** The four hidden options removed here did nothing; a yaml that still names one generates normally, with a warning. **Seeds do not change**: the same seed number generates the same layout as in v0.2.1, checked for default, SPAN and casual logic. Nothing a player sees in the game changes.
- **The mod no longer carries debug code.** When the debug channel became its own plugin (2026-09-03), its commands moved but the counters, readbacks and tuning code they drove stayed inside the mod, and later debug features followed the same pattern. All of it is in the debug plugin now, which ships in no release. That removes a Harmony patch, a per-frame check and extra reads on every planet repaint that ran in every player's game for nobody's benefit. Nothing a player sees changes. - **Retired items do nothing.** `Build Limit +1 (Tower)`, `(Cannon)` and `(Mortar)`, `Emitter Overdrive Trap` and `Greenar Refinery` have not been generated for several releases; their names stay so item ids do not move. The mod no longer applies them, so one handed out by `start_inventory`, plando or `/send` is ignored. Factory still unlocks the greenar refinery. - **Removed four hidden options that did nothing:** `trap_weight_emitter_overdrive`, `filler_energy_storage_weight`, `filler_base_generation_weight` and `filler_build_limit_weight`. A yaml that still names one generates normally, with a warning. - **Slot data no longer sends** `mission_titles`, `span_missions`, `mission_requirements` or `ern_per_item`, none of which the mod read. The mod ignores them in an older seed. Placements are unchanged: checked old against new on the same seed for default, SPAN and casual logic. - **The apworld no longer carries test-only code.** The tests and audit tools record what the world placed from outside it, and the hooks the world kept for them are gone. SPAN map notes moved from the shipped `span_data.py` to the tools-side `tools/span_notes.py`. - **The game page** lists all three recommended options and describes the `easy` logic tier. - **Release checks are exact.** `tools/check_release.py` holds the mod zip and the `.apworld` to exact file lists instead of a blocklist, and reads the shipped DLLs' metadata for the debug-only names removed here. - **Corrected comments that were wrong**, among them a tracker colour that never existed: a mission with some checks reachable and some not is drawn green.

entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v3.0.2
entry.content:
## Librarian-AP v3.0.2
Traps, a higher spare book percent for custom goals, and four fixes.
**Existing runs keep working.** Install over 3.0.1 and reconnect. The end door fix works on a run in progress; the other three fixes and the new options need a seed generated with the new apworld. A 3.0.1 YAML still works, but see the trap note below.
## New: traps
Traps are items that make things harder for a short while. They take the place of filler, never of anything a check or your goal depends on, and nothing a trap does is saved into your game.
**Traps are on by default.** A YAML that says nothing about them gets about 10% of its filler turned into traps, and that includes a 3.0.1 YAML regenerated with the new apworld. Set `trap_percentage: 0` for a seed with none.
```yaml trap_percentage: 10 # 0-100, default 10 trap_weights: # how often each one comes up; 0 turns it off Fatigue: 2 Floor Shuffle: 2 Veil: 2 Butterfingers: 2 Scramble Shelf: 1 Shelf Spill: 1 ```
| Trap | What it does | |---|---| | Fatigue | One magic skill recovers slowly for two minutes. | | Floor Shuffle | The loose books lying on the floor swap places with each other. | | Veil | The loose books you could pick up are hidden for 30 seconds, then come back. | | Butterfingers | Some of the books in your hands, from one up to all of them, fall beside you in a pile. | | Scramble Shelf | A few books in a row you have not finished trade places. | | Shelf Spill | A few books in a row you have not finished fall out onto the floor in front of their bookcase. |
The shelf traps never touch a finished row, so a completed row and its check stay done. Their notice says which bookcase and row they hit, for example "Scramble Shelf: 2 books on bookcase 2J, row 1 are out of order", and says so when one is skipped because you are carrying books or the shelves are empty. A notice shows on screen when a trap takes effect. In the multiworld the items end in "Trap", for example `Veil Trap` and `Sort Fatigue Trap`.
**Fatigue changed.** In 3.0.1 every seed had a fixed set of up to ten Fatigue items. Fatigue is now one of the traps above, so how many you get follows `trap_percentage` and its weight.
## New: higher `spare_book_item_percent` on custom goals
```yaml spare_book_item_percent: 10 # 0-100, default 10 ```
The range goes up to 100. Past 20 it only works on `goal: custom`, and only when the host allows it (`allow_high_spare_book_percent` in `host.yaml`, off by default). Other goals are held at 20.
## Fix: you could leave through the end door before your goal
Once every book you had unlocked was shelved, the game let you leave through the library door and play the ending before your Archipelago goal was reached. The door now stays shut until the goal is reached.
## Fix: individual book unlocks with count checks never showed any books
With `unlock_mode: individual_book_unlocks` and `check_mode: count`, the books you received never appeared. Seeds generated with the new apworld reveal them as they arrive.
## Fix: booksanity milestones were in logic from the start
With `check_mode: booksanity`, the "Correctly shelve N books" checks (with series unlocks) and, on floor and custom goals, the Reached Level checks past what the seed's rows can reach were in logic from the start, so the tracker showed them early and items could be placed on them out of reach. New seeds gate them by the books and rows you can actually shelve.
## Fix: random book bundles all came from the two starting sections
With `unlock_mode: random_book_bundle` and `bookcase_unlocks: unlocked`, the first bundles all came from the two starting sections instead of from across the library. Seeds generated with the new apworld draw every bundle from the whole library.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop > `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. **Both are required.** > The title screen should read `LibAP v3.0.2`.
## If something breaks
Press F8, then send that session's log from `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

entry.title: Death's Door v0.4.2
entry.content:
# Death's Door Archipelago 0.4.2
Use apworld 0.4.2 together with mod 0.4.2. Seeds generated with apworld 0.4.0 or 0.4.1 also work with mod 0.4.2.
## Mod (ArchipelagoRandomizer 0.4.2)
### Skip Cutscenes - The late-game story scenes are now skipped, including on saves that are already under way: - the Grey Crow opening Death's Door - the Grey Crow and Death in the void - Death's talk after the Grey Crow fight - the crows' scene in the Hall of Doors - the Lord of Doors' speeches before the gauntlet and during the final fight - The camera pans that show what you just opened are now skipped too. These include the Castle Lockstone braziers, the Lost Cemetery ghosts, crow souls flying into an Ancient Door, and doors, levers and cleared fights. - The ending after the Lord of Doors and the credits still play. - The few cutscenes that can leave invisible walls behind are always skipped, whether or not Skip Cutscenes is on.
### Shop - With Shop Hints on, looking at a stat in the shop shows the item its next upgrade holds and hints it. - Progressive Strength, Dexterity, Haste and Magic now show the shop's stat icons, in white, in popups and in the Recent Items list.
### Door and stat tracker - While the game is paused, press Tab (keyboard) or Y (controller) to open a tracker panel. A small hint in the bottom-left of the pause menu shows this: - With entrance randomization, the doors of the area you're in and where each one leads once you've been through it. In coupled seeds the way back counts too. Page Up / Page Down or the triggers show other areas. - With Shop Upgrades on, the level you've received for each stat and how many of its upgrades you've bought. - The shop's description panel now shows your current level of each stat. The shop's bars only show what you bought.
### DeathLink - Fixed the game crashing when it received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're rolling, invincible or just respawned is no longer lost. It kills you as soon as it can. - Fixed your own deaths sometimes not being sent after you received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're already dead no longer kills you again after respawning. - The game now shows who caused a DeathLink when it kills you.
### Fixes - Fixed a possible crash when the connection to the server drops. - The Grove of Spirits Door check is now sent when you arrive in the Hall of Doors, even with Skip Cutscenes off. - Fixed short freezes when planting a Life Seed in a new pot. They happened even with planting checks off. - Fixed a freeze in entrance randomizer seeds when a door led to another door in the same area, such as one Hall of Doors door to another. - Fixed a bug in ItemChanger that logged an error every frame in some areas. This made log files grow to over 100 MB and could cause stutter.
## APWorld (deaths_door 0.4.2) - Every Life Seed now counts towards the logic. The tracker now shows the Green Tablet and the goal as reachable once you've planted enough seeds. - On the Universal Tracker map: - Planting pot pins follow each pot's own requirements. The Crypt pot needs Fire. - The Imp Loft pot pin has moved to the Ceramic Manor left wing. - The "Beat the Lord of Doors" and "Open the Green Ancient Tablet Door" pins only light up once you can actually do them. - Entrance randomizer never connects two Hall of Doors doors to each other. - Grunt's Old Mask is no longer shown as glitched in the tracker when you can actually get it. - Leaving Ceramic Manor through the gate to the Estate of the Urn Witch is now in logic. The gate opens from the inside, day or night. - Universal Tracker's `/get_logical_path <place>` now lists the doors to take from the Hall of Doors, in order, with where each one actually leads in your seed. It only uses doors you've been through and paths you can walk with your current items. - New option **Shop Hints** (on by default). It controls the shop preview and hints described above. - Corrected the descriptions of Extra Life Seeds and Planted Pots Required.
## README - The mod and apworld READMEs are now one README, attached to this release and included in the mod zip. It covers setup from start to finish, every in-game Mod Option and every yaml option, including the new shop and planting options.

entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.29.0r2
entry.content:
# v0.29.2 � Cell Tower escape fixes
**October 22, 2026. Client 0.76.2 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**
## Fixed
- Cell Tower Access now keeps the return gate from the Central Mainframe room toward the Cell Tower phone usable, including its interaction, before the native level-attempt requirement is met. - Leaving that room toward Lobby before Fish Tears delivery now returns the player safely to Music Lab, avoiding the upper-Lobby hand-blocker trap. After delivery, the normal route remains subject to existing area ownership checks. - These repairs do not complete quests, grant items, send checks or change generated progression rules.
## Updating
Close the game and install **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.2.zip**, retaining its included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. APWorld remains **0.29.0**; the unchanged APWorld download is included for convenience. No regeneration or tracker update is required for this client patch.
## Validation and scope
Both reported escape routes passed targeted user gameplay testing. The release contains the accepted native-interaction repair with a version-label update. Native-reference tests cover exact condition validation, idempotence, wrong flags/classes and failed writes; existing routing regressions are also covered. Full release validation is recorded in [testing](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/TESTING.md).
Separate investigation confirmed early Violance did not prevent Old Tom's note in the tested post-nectar state, and the Cell Tower Star Eater did not require Cold Storage completion after leaving and returning. Complete prerequisites are not yet isolated, so generation logic remains unchanged.
Intermittent performance stalls, extended-session/multiplayer coverage and remaining native-rule uncertainties remain in [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). This release does not claim to resolve those reports.
See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) and [gate acceptance record](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/testing/2026-10-22-hub-escape.md).
Release validation: all 45 client regression projects passed, the Release build completed with zero warnings/errors, repository validation passed, and all 10 packaging tests passed. The APWorld asset is reused byte-for-byte from v0.29.1.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.7.0rc4

## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.4
**Pre-release.** Fourth test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
This RC only lists what changed since the **[v0.7.0-rc.3 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.3)**. For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**.

- **The Biome Finder screen is a map.** Right-clicking the Biome Finder now shows a top-down map of the biomes around you, next to a searchable list of every biome in your dimension. Click a spot on the map or a name in the list to track it. - **An arrow points the way.** While you track a biome, a small arrowhead floats just ahead of your view and turns toward it, like a compass needle. It faces you while you glide, swim or crawl. Its textures live in `textures/misc/biome_finder_arrow/`, so resource packs can replace them. - **Clearing the target.** The biome you're tracking sits at the top of the screen with a ✕ to stop tracking it. Tracking also stops on its own once you walk into that biome.

- **Only the mod jar changed.** Keep the rc.3 apworld and your YAMLs.
